title: Find and replace
description:
Search a document with the options an editor's Find dialog has.

```
find "cat" (match case off): 3 matches
find "cat" whole word: 2 (not "category")
replace all "cat" -> "dog", whole word: "The dog sat. dog food. category"
find next from position 10 wraps around to the start
```
hints: A whole word has no letter or digit just before and just after the match (lesson 6.01).
For "match case off", lower-case copies of both and search those; the positions are the same.
requirements: Options: match case, whole word, wrap around.
`findNext(text, query, from, options)` returns a position or nothing.
`replaceAll` replaces from left to right and does not re-scan replaced text.
stretch: Keep the case of each replaced word ("Cat" becomes "Dog").
